player_0.content: New plan: I failed because my description was too detailed and descriptive, which likely allowed the opponent to guess the word too easily or gave away too much information, violating the spirit of the "3 tries" win condition. Next time, I will use a much shorter, more abstract clue that hints at the word's function or shape without naming it or describing its parts (like "handle" or "concave end"). I will aim for a one-sentence clue that is vague enough to prevent an immediate guess but specific enough to guide them within three attempts, such as "A tool for serving soup that has a long handle."
